subject: english-language
source_note: Topic structure follows the Cambridge IGCSE IGCSE First Language English specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Comprehension of a text is the prerequisite for the closer analysis of how its language and structure create meaning
Directed writing tasks require students to extract and re-purpose ideas from a source they have analysed
Directed writing depends on accurate reading of the stimulus text before responding to it
Studying writers' techniques models the descriptive and narrative craft students reproduce in composition
Both writing tasks build control of audience, structure and accuracy, moving from source-bound to free composition
Coursework extends descriptive and narrative writing into longer, redrafted pieces
Coursework rewards the same analytical awareness of language applied reflectively to one's own writing
